page_title: TOR 2-0 CAG | Torino v Cagliari 24/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
90+3' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who smothers the ball.
90+2' Che Adams (Torino) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' 52:48 – the latest ball possession ratio.
87' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
87' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
87' The ball is cleared after Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Cagliari win a corner kick.

86' Che Adams has a look up and finds Karol Linetty (Torino) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
84' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Yann Karamoh will be replaced by Alieu Njie (Torino).
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Karol Linetty (Torino) is replacing Samuele Ricci.

84' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) meets a cross from Tommaso Augello, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
82' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
81' Torino are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
80' Cagliari take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
80' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
77' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
77' Here is a change. Borna Sosa is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Adam Masina (Torino).
76' Today's match ends for Roberto Piccoli who will be replaced by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari).
76' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. Torino force their opponents to concede a corner.
76' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Valentino Lazaro (Torino), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
75' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
74' Cagliari enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
73' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
72' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Cagliari win a corner.
71' Foul! Saul Coco (Torino) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
71' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Yann Karamoh.
70' Yann Karamoh (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
69' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 6:0.
66' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Adrien Tameze and he is replaced by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).
66' Substitution. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) replaces Marcus Pedersen.
66' Borna Sosa (Torino) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
65' The Cagliari players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
61' 2 - 0 Goal! Che Adams (Torino) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Elia Caprile. He makes it 2:0.
61' Yann Karamoh (Torino) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
61' Che Adams (Torino) squanders a great opportunity after striking the ball onto the post! The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
60' Torino force a corner. They send men into the box.
58' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) replaces Gianluca Gaetano.
58' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Alessandro Deiola is replaced by Michel Adopo (Cagliari).
58' Substitution. Razvan Marin did his best and is replaced by Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari).
57' The manager makes a subsitution with Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) coming on for Adam Obert.
57' The corner kick from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
54' Elia Caprile makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Adrien Tameze (Torino) after a cross from the side.
52' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
51' Celebrations are cut short for Torino as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
49' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Torino players aren’t happy.
49' Goal - 2:0! Yann Karamoh laid the ball off to Valentino Lazaro (Torino), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
46' Referee Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

44' Great solo effort by Yann Karamoh (Torino) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Yann Karamoh (Torino) sends a chip pass into the box, but Elia Caprile is quickest to intercept the ball.
40' Torino are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
39' An attempted cross from Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is cleared.
36' A lofted cross from Yann Karamoh (Torino) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
35' Kevin Bonacina blows for a foul after Marcus Pedersen (Torino) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
31' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Valentino Lazaro (Torino), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
31' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:0.

28' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header, but sent the ball into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
26' Elia Caprile (Cagliari) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
24' Elia Caprile (Cagliari) picks up an injury.
24' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) sends a long cross over to Yann Karamoh, but Elia Caprile comes forward to gather the ball.
23' Torino seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

22' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Kevin Bonacina with no other option than to blow for a foul.
20' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
18' Cagliari are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
17' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
15' Torino control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' The percentage of ball possession is – 62:38.
11' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
9' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

6' 1 - 0 Fantastic team effort! Samuele Ricci is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Che Adams (Torino) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the inside of the left post to make the score 1:0.
5' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

4' Yann Karamoh (Torino) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Torino.
4' Good movement by Yann Karamoh (Torino), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
2' Yann Karamoh (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Kevin Bonacina will referee today's match.
